description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of maximum ambiguity values across different standard deviations. The chart contains six slices, each representing a combination of standard deviation and maximum ambiguity. A dark blue slice labeled “Std: 0.0” occupies approximately 38.0% of the chart, while a lighter blue slice labeled “Std: 0.47” represents 39.0%. A medium blue slice labeled “Std: 0.82” accounts for roughly 49.0% of the chart, and a lighter shade of blue labeled “Std: 0.94” comprises 47.7%. Additionally, a green slice labeled “Max: 1” takes up about 7.0% and a light green slice labeled “Max: 2” represents 5.0%. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner detailing the color-coding for each standard deviation value, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered visually by decreasing proportion, starting with the largest dark blue slice and moving clockwise.
